structure: Single K-12 document of tables. Order: cover, TOC, introduction/how to read, color-coded anchor standards table (Anchor Standards 1-27: Civics 1-4, Economics/Personal Financial Literacy 5-10, Geography 11-14, History 15-19, Ethnic Cultural and Identity Studies 20-22, Inquiry 23-27), then one section per grade (heading 'Kindergarten', 'First Grade' ... 'Eighth Grade') and per HS course (headings 'HS Civics', 'HS Economics', 'HS Geography', 'HS New Mexico History', 'HS U.S. History', 'HS World History', 'Ethnic, Cultural, and Identity Studies'). Each section begins with an Inquiry table (Anchor Standards 23-27) followed by Theme tables ('Theme N: title'). Each table has header cells 'Anchor Standard / Performance Standard'; column C1 holds strand + anchor standard number and name (wrapped over several rows), column C2 holds the performance standards with codes (K.1, 1.1 ... 8.105; HS 9-12.Civ.n, 9-12.Econ.n, 9-12.Geo.n, 9-12.NMH.n, 9-12.US.n, 9-12.WH.n, 9-12.ECI.n). HS World History also has a Sample Topics/Themes by Time Period table. Back matter: glossary. No separate examples blocks apart from the World History sample table.
